recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. The current source already satisfies FHIR-12955 after later canonical-resource wording refinements; re-adding the original 2017 sentence verbatim would be redundant and could conflict with the maintained shared wording.
issue_request: FHIR-12955 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 and requested clarification that SearchParameter.url and parallel canonical url elements identify artifacts with an absolute URI, not necessarily a resolvable URL locator. The resolution directed url element definitions to use absolute URI wording and comments saying URL resolution is desired but cannot be relied on.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit c95931bd5ead4f3f75c935595926ef8494ae05d8, '#12955 - fix comments about URL', which changed the then-shared MetadataResource.url template definition and comments.
additional_context: FHIR-13699 raised the same URI-vs-URL concern for CodeSystem.url and was resolved No Change by reference to FHIR-12955. Later source evolution moved the common wording into active CanonicalResource/Shareable/resource-specific StructureDefinition sources, added meta.source guidance for current source location, and corrected wording defects such as FHIR-28183.
reconciliation: No source change was made. SearchParameter is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/searchparameter/structuredefinition-SearchParameter.xml defines SearchParameter.url as a uri with absolute URI/canonical identifier wording and comments explaining that a resource may no longer be found at the stated url. Active shared canonical/shareable source uses the same semantics, and targeted searches did not find an active canonical url definition retaining the old 'SHALL be a URL' rule.
